title: Everyday Debates
description: Habits everyone has an opinion on.

Window seat or aisle seat?
Would you rather text or call?
Morning person or night owl?

Beach or mountains?
Summer or winter?
Cats or dogs?
Do you sleep with a fan on?
Is your phone on silent right now?
Notifications: clear them, or let them pile up?
Socks in bed?
Bath or shower?
When the alarm goes off: up right away, or snooze?
Charge your phone at 20%, or run it down to 1%?
Tea or coffee?
Do you talk to yourself?
Would you rather be too hot or too cold?
Do you sleep with the closet door closed?
Read the book first, or watch the movie first?
Shoes off at home?
Paper towels or hand dryer?
Do you sing in the shower?
Pack the night before, or the morning of?
Music on, or quiet, while you work?
Do you keep your phone screen brightness all the way up?
